# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b104 — no horizontal weather scrollbars

Built directly on the validated v0.6.0b103 release. No backend, PID, HVAC,
sensor, window/ventilation policy, physical device controls or timers changed.

- Removed horizontal scrolling and visible scrollbar chrome from the compact
  outdoor weather/air row. AQI and active warning chips now flex to the card
  width and cannot expand beyond it, including 320–800px responsive layouts.
- Long DWD weather-warning headlines show their actual event/type first
  (for example **Entwarnung: Kampfmittelfund**). The original full headline,
  locality and entire description remain in the tooltip and the clickable,
  pinned details popup. No native warning data is discarded.
- Weather chips, secondary blockers and AQI use minimum-width zero, flexible
  sizing and ellipsis only where the narrow row genuinely cannot display
  all text. This preserves HEM's established compact two-row banner.
- Warning detail dialog continues to be scrollable for long attributes but
  hides its scrollbar visual; touch, mouse and keyboard scrolling remain
  functional.
- Added Chromium regression for 320, 340, 360, 390, 480, 590 and 800px
  layouts: zero horizontally scrollable weather overflow, visible click
  targets, original full warning text in the dialog and no scrollbar chrome.
- The complete inherited Beta103 backend/physical safety tests and browser
  suites run as release gates.

Every physical controller and weather-safety decision remains unchanged.
